value.text: SDK audit: pinned 2026.10.20 exposes no expectedRevision/ifUnchanged on close or BulkItemCloseMutation; BulkItemUpdateMutation.match applies only to updates, and runWithItemMutationPrecondition is internal, not a public export. Use public runWithActiveExtensions plus setActiveExtensionHooks beforeMutation to compare hashDocument(context.before) inside the SDK per-item lock before persistence. This preserves normal close validation, workflow policy, history and atomic close evidence. Needed upstream API: close(id, reason, { expectedItemHash }, clientOptions), checked under the same item lock with a stable revision-conflict refusal. Retry selection only for the conflicted item once. Audit: tags, links, criteria chronology, status, comments and body are read-only inputs covered by the exact document hash; close writes completed_at, resolution, expected_result, actual_result and close_reason together. No independent tag/link/comment/criteria mutation path exists in closeout.
